doc.summary: Security helpers for LazyOwn — anti-debug, certificate generation.
doc.description:
Extracted from ``utils.py`` to break the giant monolith and keep
security-critical code in one auditable location.

doc.summary: Check for debugger attachment and exit if found.
doc.description:
Reads ``/proc/self/status`` for ``TracerPid``. If a tracer is
attached and we are not running under a legitimate dev tool
(gdb, strace, ltrace will show), the process exits immediately.

This is called at import time by both ``lazyown.py`` and
``lazyc2.py``.

name: generate_certificates
signature: def generate_certificates(output_dir: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]

doc.summary: Generate a self-signed CA certificate and key pair.
doc.description:
Creates ``cert.pem`` and ``key.pem`` in the current directory (or
``output_dir`` if specified). Uses OpenSSL with 4096-bit RSA and
a 3650-day validity period.

params.name: output_dir
params.description: Optional directory to write the certificate files into. Defaults to the current working directory.
